params.name: serial

params.name: operations
params.description: Optional parameter to filter commands by operation. Allowed values are disableDownstreamPower, enableDownstreamPower, cycleDownstreamPower, and refreshData.

params.name: perPage
params.description: The number of entries per page returned. Acceptable range is 3 - 1000. Default is 10.

params.name: startingAfter
params.description: A token used by the server to indicate the start of the page. Often this is a timestamp or an ID but it is not limited to those. This parameter should not be defined by client applications. The link for the first, last, prev, or next page in the HTTP Link header should define it.

params.name: endingBefore
params.description: A token used by the server to indicate the end of the page. Often this is a timestamp or an ID but it is not limited to those. This parameter should not be defined by client applications. The link for the first, last, prev, or next page in the HTTP Link header should define it.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sorted order of entries. Order options are 'ascending' and 'descending'. Default is 'descending'.

params.name: t0
params.description: The beginning of the timespan for the data. The maximum lookback period is 30 days from today.

params.name: t1
params.description: The end of the timespan for the data. t1 can be a maximum of 30 days after t0.

params.name: timespan
params.description: The timespan for which the information will be fetched. If specifying timespan, do not specify parameters t0 and t1. The value must be in seconds and be less than or equal to 30 days. The default is 30 days.

info.name: Return an overview of alert occurrences over a timespan, by metric

params.name: networkId
params.description: Network ID

params.name: t0
params.description: The beginning of the timespan for the data. The maximum lookback period is 731 days from today.

params.name: t1
params.description: The end of the timespan for the data. t1 can be a maximum of 366 days after t0.

params.name: timespan
params.description: The timespan for which the information will be fetched. If specifying timespan, do not specify parameters t0 and t1. The value must be in seconds and be less than or equal to 366 days. The default is 7 days. If interval is provided, the timespan will be autocalculated.

params.name: interval
params.description: The time interval in seconds for returned data. The valid intervals are: 900, 3600, 86400, 604800, 2629746. The default is 604800. Interval is calculated if time params are provided.
